title: Digital Platform and Website Executive
description:
Digital Platform and Website Executive (2687)
- Location:Oxford UK/ (with the ability to work from home under Oxfam GB's hybrid working arrangements)
- Workplace Type:Hybrid
- Hours:36 hours per week
- Salary:£28,057 with a discretionary range up to £30,761 depending on experience
- Job Family:Communications
- Division:CEO Office
- Grade:D
- Job Type:Open ended
- Closing Date:22 November 2026
- Country:United Kingdom

Oxfam is a global movement of people working together to end the injustice of poverty.

About the Role:

As part of an established team of digital experts, you'll play a key role in triaging and actioning website content update requests and digital platform management requests, whilst liaising with teams across Oxfam GB. You'll also support quality assurance activities and help ensure our digital platforms run smoothly and deliver a positive user experience.

This is a great role for someone at any stage of their career who likes variety, can work autonomously and wants to grow their digital expertise.

Because the website is on a content management system (CMS), this role does not require any coding experience.

Location: Oxford-based (Hybrid with up to 2 team days in the Oxford office per month required)

If you have any questions about the role, we'd love to hear from you.Please e-mail us at , making sure you include the job title and reference number of the role you're asking about.Please be aware we are unable to accept CVs or applications via e-mail.To apply, please use the "apply now" button on the right hand side of this advertisement

Your Cover Letter:

We are looking to interview people who share our values. Therefore, we ask applicants to write a covering letter answering these questions:
- How have you actively challenged your own unconscious biases and have worked to correct inequalities in the workplace?
- How do you support people's freedom to express ideas and opinions while also making sure no one faces discrimination?

If you find these questions hard to answer, think about what these points mean to you and share your thoughts and how they reflect your personal values.

Key Responsibilities:
- Triaging and actioning day-to-day website content updates.
- Edit, format, and publish web pages, blogs and media using our content management system (CMS).
- Administer digital platforms: support user permissions, cloud services, identify and fix broken links, test functionality and report technical issues.

We're looking for someone who has:
- Familiarity with CMS platforms and web design principles.
- Strong communication and organisational skills, with excellent attention to detail.
- A commitment to Oxfam's values, feminist principles and safeguarding requirements.

It would be a bonus if you also have familiarity with:
- AI and other technologies to improve processes and save time.
- Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG)
- Project management and work tracking software, i.e. Jira, Trello or Monday.
- User Experience (UX) design methodologies.

We offer:

We offer a competitive salary and a range of additional benefits to staff including flexible working options, generous pension scheme, annual leave, additional leave allowances, company sick pay, life assurance and a range of other benefits.

From the day you join Oxfam we invite you to stretch and learn in your role. Our wide range of Learning & Development opportunities includes in-house courses, e-learning modules, on-the job learning opportunities, coaching and mentoring, and much more.

You can read more about all Oxfam has to offer

How to apply:

As part of your online application, please upload your up to date CV and Cover Letter (see format above) explaining your suitability against the essential criteria in the job profile.

Our values and commitment to safeguarding

Oxfam is committed to preventing any type of unwanted behaviour at work including sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity and financial misconduct; and committed to promoting the welfare of children, young people, adults and beneficiaries with whom Oxfam GB engages. Oxfam expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment through our code of conduct. We place a high priority on ensuring that only those who share and demonstrate our are recruited to work for us.

The post holder will undertake the appropriate level of training and is responsible for ensuring that they understand and work within the safeguarding policies of the organisation.

All offers of employment will be subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks, which can include criminal records and terrorism finance checks. Oxfam GB also participates in the .In line with this Scheme, we will request information from job applicants' previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during employment, or incidents under investigation when the applicant left employment. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms his/her understanding of these recruitment procedures.

We are committed to ensuring diversity and gender equality within our organisation and encourage applicants from diverse backgrounds to apply.

About us

Oxfam is a global community who believe poverty isn't inevitable. It's an injustice that can be overcome. We are shop volunteers, women's right activists, marathon runners, aid workers, coffee farmers, street fundraisers, goat herders, policy experts, campaigners, water engineers and more. And we won't stop until everyone can live life without poverty for good.

is a member of of 21 organisations working together with partners and local communities in the areas of humanitarian, development and campaigning, in more than 90 countries.

A thriving diverse Oxfam:

It's people power that brings about change. To play our part as a global organisation working to overcome poverty and inequality, we need equality, diversity and inclusion across our community of staff, partners and volunteers. Together, we're committed to becoming a more diverse workforce, better able to tackle the global challenges that face our world today.

To do that:
- We need to dismantle the unequal power structures that exist everywhere, this including Oxfam and the wider development and charity sectors.
- We need an inclusive Oxfam where everyone can bring who they are to our work and feels celebrated for the differences they bring.
- We want and need everyone, and that means we need you.

title: Direct Despatch Administrator - E-Commerce Team
company: MP Jobs Ltd t/a MP Recruitment Group - Agency - Permanent
advertiser_name: MP Jobs Ltd t/a MP Recruitment Group
description:
Direct Despatch Administrator

Join a busy, fast-paced team where organisation, accuracy and teamwork make a real difference!

Are you highly organised, confident with Excel and enjoy keeping things running smoothly? We're looking for a proactive Direct Despatch Administrator to join our E-Commerce team, supporting the day-to-day management of customer orders, stock availability and sales administration. This is a varied role where you'll work closely with customers, sales teams, warehouse and finance colleagues to ensure orders are processed efficiently, deliveries run smoothly and customers receive an excellent service.Previous experience with B2 B portals would be an advantage, but it's not essential. Full training will be provided, making this an excellent opportunity for someone with strong administrative skills who enjoys working with data, solving problems and being part of a supportive team.

Please note: This is a fully office-based position, with some bank holiday working required.

Responsibilities as a Despatch Administrator:
- Managing Customer Orders: Importing and processing orders from B2 B portals into the internal Sage system using Excel, ensuring all information is accurate and up to date.
- Keeping Sales on Track: Monitoring stock allocations, reservations and forecasts to help maximise sales opportunities with dropship customers.
- Building Customer Relationships: Liaising with buyers and stock management teams to provide updates on order progress, stock availability and delivery schedules.
- Supporting Sales Performance: Maintaining customer listings and price lists, preparing sales figures for Key Sales Managers and helping create engaging sales presentations.
- Resolving Queries: Acting as a key contact for order and invoice queries, working with customers and internal teams to resolve issues quickly and professionally.
- Managing Returns and Credits: Using Sage to raise sales orders, credits and debits where products are faulty, damaged or no longer required.
- Working Across Teams: Collaborating with warehouse and finance colleagues to keep orders moving and ensure everything runs efficiently.
- Supporting E-Commerce Operations: Assisting with product imports, product information, sample requests and general order processing.

About you:
- Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
- Confident IT skills, particularly Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise a varied workload.
- Clear communication skills and a professional, customer-focused approach.
- A positive, can-do attitude and the ability to work collaboratively.
- The confidence to work under pressure while maintaining high standards.

Experience with B2 B portals or order-processing systems would be beneficial, but it's not essential.

We're happy to provide comprehensive training for someone with the right attitude, aptitude and willingness to learn.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to become an important part of a busy E-Commerce team, gaining exposure to sales administration, customer relationships, stock management and order fulfilment. No two days need to be the same, and you'll play a key role in helping the business deliver an efficient and reliable service to its customers. If you're organised, enthusiastic and enjoy being at the heart of a team that gets things done, we'd love to hear from you!

title: E-Commerce Marketing Executive
description:
Ecommerce Marketing Executive

Location: North Oxfordshire / Hybrid (1-2 days per week in the office)
Salary: £30,000-£32,000 DOE

About the Role

Robert Half are working with an international organisation to recruit an Ecommerce Marketing Executive to join its growing digital content team.

This is an exciting opportunity for an organised and proactive ecommerce professional to support the creation, management and optimisation of digital content across Amazon, and Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) channels throughout Europe.

You'll play a key role in bringing products to market, supporting new product launches, managing digital merchandising assets and ensuring content is accurate, engaging and delivered on time. Working closely with internal teams, agencies and European stakeholders, you'll help deliver a consistent and high-quality customer experience across multiple digital channels.

Key Responsibilities
- Create and manage digital merchandising assets, product imagery, carousel assets and enhanced product content.
- Manage content deployment, updates and refreshes across Amazon, and DTC platforms.
- Support new product launches, coordinating content, assets, timelines and deployment schedules.
- Work with creative and internal teams to ensure content meets brand, retailer and channel requirements.
- Support localisation and adaptation of content across European markets.
- Maintain digital asset libraries, content systems and supporting documentation.
- Conduct regular content audits and proactively identify and resolve content issues or inconsistencies.
- Support content optimisation using ecommerce best practice, performance insights and customer data.
- Work collaboratively with marketing, product, category and other cross-functional teams to deliver projects on time.
- Contribute to improving content processes and the overall efficiency of digital content deployment.

About You

We're looking for someone with around 1-3 years' experience in ecommerce, digital content, digital marketing or ecommerce operations who is keen to develop their career in a fast-paced, international environment.

You'll ideally have:
- Experience managing content across ecommerce or retailer platforms.
- Amazon Vendor Central experience.
- Salesforce experience.
- Experience with retailer content platforms and ecommerce systems.
- Experience supporting product launches and digital content deployment.
- Experience working with Adobe Creative Suite.
- A good understanding of ecommerce content and online customer journeys.
- Strong organisational and project coordination skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Experience working with European stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

Experience with Amazon A+ or Premium A+ Content, PIM/DAM systems such as InRiver, localisation/translation workflows or content optimisation would be advantageous.

What We're Looking For

You'll be highly organised, process-driven and proactive, with a genuine interest in ecommerce and digital retail. You'll enjoy working in a collaborative environment, managing multiple priorities and taking ownership of projects from planning through to completion.

The Opportunity

This is a great opportunity to join an international business and gain broad exposure to ecommerce content, digital merchandising, product launches and European digital operations.

You'll have the opportunity to work across multiple digital channels, collaborate with teams across Europe and make a real contribution to how products are presented and experienced online.

Robert Half Ltd acts as an employment business for temporary positions and an employment agency for permanent positions. Robert Half is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion. Suitable candidates with equivalent qualifications and more or less experience can apply. Rates of pay and salary ranges are dependent upon your experience, qualifications and training. title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive
Hybrid Full Time Permanent
About the Employer
An established UK technology business providing IT infrastructure, data protection, disaster recovery and enterprise technology solutions to organisations across a range of sectors. Working closely with leading global technology vendors, the company combines specialist technical expertise with long-standing industry experience to help customers protect, manage and modernise business-critical IT environments.

The Role
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a hands-on Marketing Executive to join a growing B2 B technology marketing team. This practical, delivery-focused position will play an important role in turning marketing strategies into effective, measurable campaigns across digital channels.
Working closely with marketing, sales and SDR colleagues, you will build and manage campaigns in HubSpot, create landing pages and email sequences, develop marketing assets, support PPC and social media activity, and monitor campaign performance. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised marketer looking to develop their expertise in B2 B technology, campaign management and digital marketing.

Duties & Responsibilities
- Build and manage integrated marketing campaigns in HubSpot, including emails, landing pages, forms, lists, workflows and associated campaign assets.
- Maintain and organise the HubSpot portal to ensure campaigns, marketing assets, data and reporting remain accurate and consistent.
- Produce campaign reports and dashboards, monitoring marketing performance against agreed KPIs and objectives.
- Create professional landing pages, email campaigns and marketing resources in line with established brand and editorial guidelines.
- Plan, create and publish engaging social media content, particularly for LinkedIn, while supporting paid digital and PPC campaigns.
- Collaborate with marketing, SDR and sales teams to understand briefs and deliver both long-term campaigns and fast-turnaround marketing projects.
- Create and adapt visual marketing assets using Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud applications, while supporting website content development and management.
- Support channel and co-marketing campaigns with major technology vendors and strategic partners.

Education & Skills Required
- A degree in marketing or a related discipline, or an equivalent professional marketing qualification such as CIM, would be advantageous.
- Previous marketing experience, ideally within B2 B IT, technology or a channel environment such as a vendor, reseller, MSP or technology partner.
- Strong HubSpot skills covering campaign creation, management, automation, organisation, reporting and performance measurement.
- Experience creating professional landing pages, email campaigns, digital marketing content and associated campaign assets.
- Working knowledge of Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud, combined with excellent written and spoken English and strong attention to detail.
- An organised, collaborative and dependable approach, with the ability to manage varied workloads, meet deadlines and communicate effectively with sales, SDR and marketing stakeholders. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.
- Hybrid.
- Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:30pm.
- Banbury.
- Salary: 30 k to 35 k. (Depending on experience)
